headline: Binance's withdrawals are still paused after a hack it puts at about $6.3B, prices have recovered part of the overnight drop, and NYSE owner ICE plans regulated US Hyperliquid futures.

market.asOf: Read from news reports this run, not live pages: BTC and ETH as reported by Trending Topics at 06:35 UTC Fri 30 Oct (13:35 Bangkok); Fear & Greed as reported by CoinGabbar. CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap could not be opened this run and no SOL reading was found. Check the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 30, Fear, on the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index, down from 51 a day earlier, as reported by CoinGabbar and Trending Topics on 30 Oct.

stories.title: Binance hack: withdrawals still paused, about $3B frozen, reopening expected within 48 hours
stories.summary: Binance says deposits are working normally and it expects to begin restoring withdrawals within 48 hours of co-CEO Yi He's statement early Friday. It puts the hack's impact at about $6.3B, says a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop may have been the way in, and found no evidence that a private key leaked.
points: Estimates differ: Binance about $6.3B, per U.Today; Chainalysis at least $5.912B, per Reuters via Investing.com, while U.Today cites Chainalysis at about $6.4B.
About $3B has been frozen so far, per U.Today; Reuters says Binance gave no update on the rest, per Investing.com.
FinanceFeeds dates Yi He's statement to 04:17 UTC Friday, which would put the 48-hour window at about 04:17 UTC Sunday 1 Nov (11:17 Bangkok). No date has been given for a full restore.
Arkham saw $38.82M of ETH moved to a new wallet, and the attacker still holds about $1.12B in ETH, per PANews.
TRM Labs says with high confidence that North Korea's 'TraderTraitor' hackers did it, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Prices win back part of the overnight drop after more than $1.5B of forced selling
stories.summary: Bitcoin briefly fell to about $76,650, a six-week low, after the hack news, then recovered some ground by Friday morning. Leveraged bets being forced shut made the drop sharper, and the market mood index sits in 'Fear'.
points: On Friday morning bitcoin was about $78,518 (down 1.78% in 24 hours) and ether $2,245.53 (down 2.79%), per Trending Topics at 06:35 UTC.
More than $1.5B of positions were liquidated in 24 hours, almost all bets on rising prices, per Journal du Coin.
The alternative.me Fear & Greed index fell to 30 ('Fear') from 51 a day earlier, per CoinGabbar.
About $10.92B of bitcoin options expired on Deribit at 08:00 UTC today, with 'max pain' at $78,000, per Journal du Coin. No report of the outcome was available when this was written.
Coinbase shares fell 4.8% and Strategy nearly 6% in extended US trading, per Reuters via Investing.com.

sources.label: Journal du Coin: liquidations and options (French)

stories.title: NYSE owner ICE plans regulated US futures based on Hyperliquid
stories.summary: Intercontinental Exchange, which owns the New York Stock Exchange, agreed with TradeXYZ to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to US markets under regulation, subject to approval. No launch date has been set. Hyperliquid's HYPE token rose while most of the market fell.
points: ICE will build exchange and clearing systems for perpetual futures on crypto, stocks, indices, commodities and currencies, and is making a strategic investment in TradeXYZ, per The Block.
ICE CEO Jeffrey Sprecher called these markets 'additive to our futures markets, not a replacement for them,' per The Block.
HYPE was up 15% to about $91.21 when The Block reported the deal on 29 Oct; its all-time high is $97.96.
Trending Topics reported HYPE up 18% in 24 hours on Friday morning, against the market trend.

briefs.title: Ether funds lose money for a fourth day; bitcoin funds take in a little
briefs.summary: On 29 Oct US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $17.07M while ether ETFs lost $105M, per KuCoin News citing Wu Blockchain.

briefs.title: Fed held rates at 3.75%-4.00% this week, with two votes for a hike
briefs.summary: The vote on 28 Oct was 10-2; Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack wanted a quarter-point hike.

briefs.title: Other big exchanges say they were not hit
briefs.summary: Bybit's Ben Zhou and Gate's Han Lin said their platforms were not affected, and OKX's CEO proposed shared security standards across exchanges, per CoinGabbar.

briefs.title: Kraken had a one-hour outage
briefs.summary: Kraken users saw connection and order problems from about 02:42 to 03:42 UTC Friday, reportedly since fixed, per CoinGabbar.

briefs.title: Aave freezes 292 markets to stop the attacker borrowing
briefs.summary: Aave and its partners froze 292 reserves across V3 and V4; the attacker's $44.6M WETH loan is still fully backed by collateral, per LlamaRisk via CoinGabbar.

briefs.title: Standard Chartered: no new floor until funds are unfrozen
briefs.summary: Geoffrey Kendrick said only after assets are unfrozen and more detail emerges 'will we find a new base,' per Reuters via Investing.com.
